exposure: Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission (for neonates)
Having a preterm and low birth weight neonate admitted to the NICU
cohort: 140 mothers of preterm and low birth weight neonates in the NICU (cases) and 140 mothers of full-term neonates (controls)
finding: Mothers of preterm neonates admitted to the NICU had significantly higher levels of stress, anxiety, and depression compared to mothers of full-term neonates.
mod_finding: Mothers of preterm neonates who delivered via cesarean section had a significant association with higher anxiety scores.
birth_weight: Low birth weight vs. Normal birth weight
